{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders and exclude QA orders
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_clean'].idxmax()]

# Print the number of filtered rows (must be included in evidence)
print(f"Number of completed orders after excluding QA orders: {len(df_filtered)}")

# Print the results
print(total_revenue_by_channel)
print(best_channel)"}
